name: ai-money
description: Personal finance app with local-first SQLite and AI pipelines

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run --workspace=apps/mobile build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run --workspace=apps/mobile build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json
